llm_metadata.reasoning: Rebuilt DlRlcDelayModel using HistGradientBoostingRegressor trained on log1p-transformed target values (np.log1p(dl_rlc_delay)). RLC delay in 5G RAN telemetry exhibits right-skewed heavy-tailed distribution with severe transient queueing spikes. Training directly on log space stabilizes gradient boosting tree splits, prevents error explosion, and substantially lowers held-out RMSE/MAE. Included engineered features incorporating downstream predictions (dl_throughput_pred, dl_bler_pred) and lag differences.
